about: Downtown Grand Junction hosts the Spirit of Christmas Walk each December.
The 2026 walk is Friday, December 11, from 5:30 to 8:30 PM.
Downtown transforms into a Christmas village for the evening.
Businesses keep extended hours so families can browse and shop along the way.
The host lists walking light tours as part of the evening.
Carolers and extra entertainment add to the atmosphere.
Pop-up art markets appear downtown during the walk.
A Santa Con is also on the schedule.
Special shopping deals are offered by participating downtown businesses.
No admission price is listed, so the walk is treated as a free public event.
The Downtown Grand Junction website carries the full event listing.

kids: Watch the Palisade Parade of Lights
Ride the Candy Cane Train and a horse-drawn carriage
Take a picture with Santa on Main Street
about: The Palisade Chamber of Commerce says Olde Fashioned Christmas starts the holiday season in Palisade, Colorado.
The 2026 weekend is Friday, December 4, and Saturday, December 5, in downtown Palisade.
Friday runs from 4:30 to 6:30 PM and starts with a $1 Cup of Warmth at Slice O'Life Bakery.
The Taylor Christmas Carolers march at 3rd and Main at 5 PM.
The Palisade Parade of Lights begins at 5:30 PM, followed by the tree lighting and the tower lighting at the fire station at 6 PM.
Saturday runs from 10 AM to 4 PM with a free Winter Faire of artisan booths, food, warm drinks and music.
Clark's Carriage Rides run from 10:30 AM to 3:30 PM with stops at the event locations.
The Candy Cane Train and Depot at 3rd and Main is open from 10 AM to 4 PM.
Christmas Critters at 2nd and Peach runs from 10 AM to 2 PM with friendly farm animals.
Pictures with Santa are at 3rd and Kluge from 11 AM to 12:30 PM, with photo packages from Galasso Images starting at $25.
A ticketed Breakfast with Santa at 8:30 or 9:00 AM on Saturday includes a buffet, a photo with Santa, a free book and a candy cane.
The Palisade Historical Society welcomes visitors at the Palisade History Museum from 10 AM to 2 PM.
A children's Gingerbread Contest and Showcase takes entries at 9 AM on December 5.
faq: When is Olde Fashioned Christmas in Palisade?
Friday, December 4, from 4:30 to 6:30 PM and Saturday, December 5, from 10 AM to 4 PM, 2026.
What time is the Parade of Lights?
The parade begins at 5:30 PM on Friday, December 4.
The Winter Faire is free to attend. Photo packages with Santa start at $25 and the Breakfast with Santa is ticketed.
Pictures with Santa are at 3rd and Kluge on Saturday from 11 AM to 12:30 PM.
Yes, Clark's Carriage Rides and the Candy Cane Train.

site: Cross Orchards Historic Site, 3073 Patterson Rd
about: The Museums of Western Colorado hold Christmas at Cross at the Cross Orchards Historic Site.
The 2026 date is Saturday, December 19, from 9 AM to 3 PM.
The site is at 3073 Patterson Road in Grand Junction.
Admission is $5 per person and free for museum members.
Unlimited firetruck and train rides run throughout the day.
Families can visit with Santa.
Crafts are offered for kids.
Hot cocoa, cider and cookies are served.
A model train Christmas show is part of the day.
Tickets are sold through the museum's ticketing page.
The museums describe Christmas at Cross as one of their community holiday celebrations.
